fields.description: Unique name for this device (e.g., Main Office Device)
fields.label: Device Name

fields.description: Hardware serial number — must match the device_id sent by the bridge or SN sent via ADMS push. Punches from any other serial are rejected.
fields.label: Device Serial

fields.description: Optional. IP address of the biometric device — informational only (the bridge holds the real address and identifies itself by serial). Leave blank for software/database sources like HTMS-86.
fields.label: Device IP

fields.description: If unchecked, this device's punches are rejected at the API.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: Employees from OTHER companies who are allowed to punch on this device. A punch is matched to an employee of this device's own company first; only if none matches is this list consulted.
fields.label: Cross-Company Attendance

fields.description: Leave empty to restrict this device to its own company's employees.
fields.label: Allowed Employees from Other Companies

fields.description: Last time the bridge made contact (every sync cycle, even if no new punches). Heartbeat alerting is based on this field.
fields.label: Last Contact Time

fields.description: Last time at least one new punch was actually synced (data movement, not just connectivity).
fields.label: Last Sync Time

fields.description: De-duplication window in seconds. A device often fires the same physical punch several times in quick succession; a punch within this many seconds of one already kept for the day is treated as a repeat and not stored again. Set to 0 to keep only exact-timestamp de-duplication.
fields.label: Duplicate Threshold (seconds)

fields.description: Send an email to the recipients below if the device hasn't reported a sync in this many minutes.
fields.label: Alert Threshold (minutes)

fields.description: Emails to notify when this device's bridge stops syncing or recovers. Leave empty to disable alerting for this device.
fields.label: Alert Recipients
